personal.bio: I'm a Machine Learning Engineer with 5+ years of experience designing and deploying AI systems at scale. My work spans LLM fine-tuning, computer vision pipelines, and production ML infrastructure. I care deeply about bridging research and real-world impact — turning frontier ideas into reliable, maintainable systems.

experience.highlight: Data pipeline automation and model evaluation frameworks
Computer vision and embodied AI research

projects.title: NeuralSearch
projects.description: Semantic search engine powered by bi-encoder retrieval and cross-encoder reranking. Indexes 10M+ documents with sub-100ms latency using HNSW indexing and quantization.

projects.title: FineTuner Studio
projects.description: Open-source GUI for fine-tuning LLMs with LoRA and QLoRA. Supports Llama, Mistral, and Phi. One-click dataset preparation, training, and GGUF export.

projects.title: VisionPipeline
projects.description: Production-grade real-time object detection and tracking system. Processes 60 FPS video streams using YOLO + DeepSORT with ONNX runtime optimization.

projects.title: AgentBench
projects.description: Evaluation harness for LLM agents on multi-step reasoning tasks. Includes 40+ task templates spanning code generation, tool use, and planning.

projects.title: EmbedDB
projects.description: Lightweight vector database written in pure Python. Supports cosine, dot-product, and Euclidean similarity. Designed for prototyping RAG systems without infrastructure overhead.

projects.title: ChartReader
projects.description: Multimodal model that extracts structured data from scientific charts and plots. Fine-tuned on a curated dataset of 50K chart-data pairs. Achieves 91% accuracy on ChartQA.
